--- tmp/save-pdf.ps1 ---
$b64 = ''
$bytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)
$out = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..' 'LP-2026-0418.pdf'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($out, $bytes)
Write-Host "saved: $out ($($bytes.Length) bytes)"
# Inflate the FlateDecode content stream to read the text
$text = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bytes)
$start = $text.IndexOf('stream') + 6
if ($text[$start] -eq "`r") { $start++ }
if ($text[$start] -eq "`n") { $start++ }
$end = $text.IndexOf('endstream', $start)
$raw = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bytes, $start, $end - $start)
$zlib = [Convert]::FromBase64String([Convert]::ToBase64String([System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($raw)))
# raw bytes of the stream
$streamBytes = $bytes[$start..($end-1)]
# skip 2-byte zlib header
$deflate = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream(, $streamBytes[2..($streamBytes.Length-1)])
$ds = New-Object System.IO.Compression.DeflateStream($deflate, [System.IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress)
$ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
$ds.CopyTo($ms)
$ds.Close()
Write-Host '--- PDF content stream text ---'
Write-Host ([System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($ms.ToArray()))
